arabic text:
(CHALE AAO BABA, CHALE AAO BABA, CHALE AAO BABA)
SUNAATI HAI MUJHKO PHUPHIJAAN KAHAANI, KARUN
KYA MAGAR NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
CHALE AAO BABA, CHALE AAO BABA, MUJHE KHAAK PAR
NEEND AATI NAHI HAI
english translation text:
(Come back, Father; come back, Father; come back, Father.)
My aunt tells me stories, but what can I do?
Sleep will not come.
Come back, Father; come back, Father—upon the dust,
I cannot sleep.

arabic text: KALEJE MAI UTHTA HAI IK DARD AISA,
english translation text: A pain rises within my heart—

arabic text: KE JISKE LIYE NA DAWAA NA DILAASA\nMAI KAL TAK TOH SINE PE SOTI THI BABA,\nYEHI SOCH KAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: —a pain for which there is neither medicine nor comfort.\nUntil yesterday I slept upon your chest, Father.\nThinking of this, I cannot sleep.

arabic text: HUWAA KYUN NA JAANE SITAMGAR ZAMAANA,
english translation text: Why has the world become so cruel?

arabic text: KABHI GURKHIYAN DE KABHI TAZIYANA\nYEHI KHAUF HAI JO SATATA HAI MUJHKO,\nISSI BAAT PAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: Sometimes it rebukes me; sometimes it strikes me with a whip.\nThis fear keeps tormenting me.\nBecause of it, I cannot sleep.

arabic text: RULAATI HAI MUJHKO LAEENON KI BAATEIN,
english translation text: The words of the accursed make me weep.

arabic text: GUZARTI HAI AISE YATEEMI KI RAATEIN\nKAHIN SHIMR AAKAR TAMAACHE NA MAARE,\nHAI DIL MAI YEH DAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: Thus pass the nights of my orphanhood.\nI fear that Shimr may come and slap me again.\nThis fear fills my heart; I cannot sleep.

arabic text: KHABAR HAI YEH MUJHKO KHATAA MERI KYA HAI,
english translation text: I know what my supposed crime is—

arabic text: YEHI NA KE JADD MERA MUSHKIL KUSHA HAI\nSUNAAYE WOH MUSHKIL KUSHA MUJHKO LORI,\nUNHE DO KHABAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: —only that my ancestor is the Remover of Difficulties.\nLet that Remover of Difficulties sing me a lullaby.\nTell him that I cannot sleep.

arabic text: YATEEMI KA EHSAAS HII IK SITAM HAI,
english translation text: The very feeling of being orphaned is an oppression.

arabic text: MUSALSAL TARAPNE SE HOTON PE GHAM HAI\nAGAR AB YEH ZINDAAN HII GHAR HAI MERA,\nCHALE AAO GHAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: Continuous anguish has brought grief to my lips.\nIf this prison is now my home,\ncome home, Father; I cannot sleep.

arabic text: KABHI MAINE SOCHA NAHIN THA YEH BABA,
KE TUMSE BICHHADKAR BHI JEENA PADHEGA\nTUMHAARE BINA HII MUJHE AB HAI JEENA,\nYEHI JAANKAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: —that I would have to live after being separated from you.\nNow I must live without you.\nKnowing this, I cannot sleep.

arabic text: PHUPHI JAA(N) SE AKSAR SUNA HAI YEH NAUHA,
english translation text: I have often heard this lament from my aunt—

arabic text: TADAPTA HAI BAN MAI SHAH-E-DEE(N) KA LAASHA\nMERE PAAS AAJAAO MAQTAL SE BABA,\nTUMHE BHI AGAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: —that the body of the King of Faith lies restless in the wilderness.\nCome to me from the battlefield, Father,\nif you too cannot sleep.

arabic text: MASAAEB NE YEH HAAL SAB KA KIYA HAI,
english translation text: Calamity has reduced everyone to this state—

arabic text: KE DIN RAAT MATAM HAI AAHO BUKAA HAI\nPHUPHI HO KE SAJJAD HO YA SAKINA,\nKISI KO IDHAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: —day and night there is mourning, sighing, and weeping.\nWhether my aunt, Sajjad, or Sakina,\nno one here can sleep.

arabic text: YEH "IRFAN-O-MAZHAR" KE DIL KI SADAA HAI,
english translation text: This is the cry from the hearts of ‘Irfan and Mazhar’—

arabic text: JAHA SHAHZADI KA MADFANN BANAA HAI\nHAI JISNE BHI DEKHA SITAM KA WO ZINDAAN,\nUSSE UMR BHAR, NEEND AATI NAHIN HAI
english translation text: —at the place where the princess was buried.\nWhoever has seen that prison of cruelty\ncan never sleep peacefully again.
